title: Classical methods for modern applications: synthetic tabular data generation using lightweight discrete response continuous latent variable model
abstract: arXiv:2610.21674v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we present a lightweight algorithm for modelling tabular data containing both continuous and discrete variables. The method uses empirical marginal distributions and a selected quantile function to transform the data into a continuous latent space, where a distribution of choice, e.g. a multivariate Gaussian, can be efficiently estimated and applied. While this approach is closely related to classical well-established machine learning methods, we present a novel adaptation that fits well within the contemporary computational ecosystem. Unlike in the case of deep architectures, it results in a simple implementation with few dependencies, robust training/estimation, as well as efficient sampling. The transformation preserves complex marginal distributions and correlations, providing high-fidelity models, especially for data with unimodal distributions. translated_title: 经典方法的现代应用：使用轻量级离散响应连续潜变量模型生成合成表格数据
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们提出了一种轻量级算法，用于对同时包含连续变量和离散变量的表格数据进行建模。该方法使用经验边际分布和选定的分位数函数将数据变换到连续潜空间中，在该空间中可以高效地估计和应用所选的分布，例如多元高斯分布。虽然这一方法与经典成熟的机器学习方法密切相关，但我们提出了一种新颖的改进，使其能够很好地融入当代的计算生态系统。与深度架构不同，该方法实现简单、依赖项少、训练与估计稳健，且采样高效。该变换能够保留复杂的边际分布和相关性，提供高保真度的模型，尤其适用于单峰分布的数据。所提方法的关键特性之一是其连续性
tldr: 本文提出一种利用经验边际分布和分位数变换将含连续与离散变量的表格数据映射到连续潜空间的轻量级生成模型，能够高保真地生成合成表格数据，且实现简单、训练稳健、采样高效。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight generative model that transforms tabular data with both continuous and discrete variables into a continuous latent space via empirical marginal distributions and quantile transforms, enabling high-fidelity synthetic data generation with simple implementation, robust training, and efficient sampling.
